summary: For early binding, log in with flightctl and run flightctl certificate request --signer=enrollment --expiration=365d --output=embedded > config.yaml to get an agent config with service URLs, CA bundle and enrollment client cert and key; add --insecure-skip-tls-verify for self-signed CAs not in the host pool.
questions: How do I get an enrollment certificate for early binding?
What does the agent config.yaml contain?
TLS verification error with flightctl and self-signed certificates
